name: The New Order Victoria 3
summary: This mod, inspired by its original Hearts of Iron IV counterpart, represents an exploration of an alternate Cold War scenario. We firmly denounce all hateful ideologies. This mod is not, under any circumstances, intended to idealize, promote or trivialize the ideologies or regimes that brought untold suffering to millions. We categorically reject any interpretation of this mod that serves as a platform for glorifying or fantasizing about such entities and their actions.
